## Lisbon Trip Plan for 2 Adults: Apr 10–13, 2026
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/map.svg

A balanced 4-day Lisbon plan with museums, walking time, seafood, and one easy beach half-day. I’m assuming a mid-range pace, public transit plus some rideshares, and hotel/apartment lodging in a central neighborhood.

## Day-by-Day Lisbon Itinerary and Budget
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/calendar.svg

Day 1: Baixa, Chiado, and Alfama introduction
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg
- Morning: Arrive, drop bags, and do a self-guided walk from Praça do Comércio to Rossio and Chiado.
- Afternoon: Visit the Lisbon Story Centre or MUDE, then wander up through Alfama viewpoints and lanes.
- Dinner: Classic seafood at a tasca near Alfama or Baixa.
- Estimated cost for 2: **€220**
  - Stay: €150
  - Food: €55
  - Transit/entry: €15

Day 2: Museum day in Belém
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- Morning: Go to Belém for the Jerónimos Monastery area and one major museum.
- Afternoon: Choose the MAAT or National Coach Museum, then walk the riverfront and stop for pastéis de nata.
- Dinner: Seafood dinner back in central Lisbon.
- Estimated cost for 2: **€250**
  - Stay: €150
  - Food: €65
  - Transit/entry: €35

Day 3: Lisbon walking tour, Mouraria, and relaxed evening
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/signpost-split.svg
- Morning: Join a guided walking tour focused on history, neighborhoods, and viewpoints.
- Afternoon: Explore Mouraria, Graça, or Castelo area at an easy pace with café breaks.
- Dinner: Seafood rice, grilled fish, or a neighborhood bistro.
- Estimated cost for 2: **€235**
  - Stay: €150
  - Food: €60
  - Tour/transit: €25

Day 4: Beach half-day in Cascais and final Lisbon evening
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/water.svg
- Morning: Take the train to Cascais for a relaxed beach half-day.
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/3/3c/Beach_near_Lisbon_Portugal%2C_1994..jpg Alt=Morning: Take the train to Cascais for a relaxed beach half-day, Lisbon, Portugal
- Afternoon: Walk the waterfront, sit by the beach, then return to Lisbon.
- Dinner: Final seafood meal in Cais do Sodré or Bairro Alto.
- Estimated cost for 2: **€255**
  - Stay: €150
  - Food: €65
  - Transit: €40

## Best Neighborhood to Stay In
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/house.svg

**Chiado / Baixa / Bairro Alto edge** is the best fit for your trip.

- Central for museums, walking tours, and dining
- Easy tram, metro, and taxi access
- Good for first-time visitors who want to do most things on foot
- Slight trade-off: can be lively at night, so choose a quieter side street or higher-floor room

### Budget fit
- Target lodging for 4 nights: **€600–€700 total**
- That leaves about **€700–€800** for food, transit, museum entries, tours, and the beach day
- Your total non-flight budget of **€1,400** is workable with a mid-range stay and a few paid attractions

## Cost Breakdown for the Full Trip
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/currency-euro.svg

- Lodging: **€600–€700**
- Food and drinks: **€280–€360**
- Museum entries and tours: **€120–€180**
- Transit and taxis: **€60–€100**
- Snacks, coffee, buffer: **€80–€120**

**Estimated total:** **€1,140–€1,460**
Best target to stay on budget: **€1,250–€1,350**

## Simple Packing Checklist
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/luggage.svg

- Comfortable walking shoes
- Light jacket or layer for evenings
- Small day bag or crossbody bag
- Sunglasses and sunscreen
- Reusable water bottle
- Portable phone charger
- Travel umbrella or compact rain shell
- Swimwear and towel for the beach half-day
- Valid ID/passport and payment cards
- Any prescription medications

## Quick Actions
Action: [Button: Find stays] https://www.booking.com/city/pt/lisbon.html
Action: [Button: Museum tickets] https://www.getyourguide.com/lisbon-l42/

- Lisbon Metro official site: https://www.metrolisboa.pt/en/
- Lisbon tourism overview: https://www.visitlisboa.com/
- Belém cultural area reference: https://www.visitlisboa.com/en/places/belem
